title: Capilla de las Capuchinas Sacramentarias
notes: Tlalpan; coloured light through a lattice and a gilded reredos
address: Miguel Hidalgo 43, Tlalpan Centro, Mexico City

detail.intro: The chapel and convent for the Capuchinas Sacramentarias del Purísimo Corazón de María in Tlalpan, where a yellow lattice window and a gilded altar screen turn daylight into colour. One of the works Barragán himself valued most.
